about: Grades against the papers (ASSISTANT grades, not independent). Run: c6 + R3b + p7 + v4.7c, setting B, the 25 frozen questions, 2026-11-14 (E25_R3b_p7_v47_c6/). 41 requests, 93,002 tokens (cap 95,000). Production unchanged.

q03.why: time-aligned text tokens before audio tokens; factuality and linguistic quality; almost triples accuracy; marginal inference cost

q04.why: 12.5 Hz, 1.1 kbps, Q = 8, N_A = 2048 (paper's 'We use' voice)

q06.why: real limitations (HNET:A:c088), not the stated motivation

q07.why: third sub-layer; masked decoder self-attention; Q from decoder, K/V from encoder output

q09.why: delay 2 -> 1 gives 160 ms; 200 ms in practice; 160 below 230 ms; misses the 80 ms frame part

q10.why: chunking layer components and two-stage design (HNET:1:c012); 2-stage significantly better than 1-stage (HNET:3.1:c049); misses encoder / main network / decoder recursion

q13.why: gives H-Net 55.5 but states 'The retrieved passages do not state the average zero-shot accuracy of the BPE Transformer' although HNET:T2:r01 (Transformer, GPT-3 Large, 53.3) was in context: a FALSE absence statement accepted (row label 'Transformer' lacks 'BPE'). The redraft dropped the correct 53.3 sentence of D0.

q14.why: byte-pair encoding ~37000 shared vocabulary (AIAYN:5.1:c025); H-Net byte-level (HNET:3.2:c061); misses 32000 word-piece and learned chunking

t29.why: SHOWN WRONG ANSWER: 'Configuration Row 5 reports ABX = 29.1%' for the configuration with no marks (expected 31.3%). Row 5 has a check under Quantization / Rate. Gold row MOSHI:T17:r01 not in context (retrieval). D0 claimed 'no marks' (rejected 0.85); the p7 redraft restated the row WITHOUT the question's condition, a true sentence (0.99) that does not answer the question.
